author: Yffe
content: Delivered in commit 2a8e3e3. Root cause: MAX_EXPR_DEPTH=256 exceeded the 2 MiB test-thread native stack (debug build overflows at ~135-140 ladder levels, ~10 frames/level), so the guard never fired before SIGABRT. Fix: lowered MAX_EXPR_DEPTH 256->64 in thermite-syntax/src/parser.rs (single file) — 1500 nested parens now return the structured ExpressionTooDeep diagnostic instead of aborting (parser.md AC-4 / REQ-4, goal.md R-CODE-2). All nested-expr re-entry points (parse_primary paren case, parse_call_args, parse_index_arg, parse_closure, parse_match, parse_if_expr) confirmed routed through the guarded parse_expr. Un-ignored divergence_deep_nesting_no_panic. Gauntlet: cargo test 12 passed/0 failed/0 ignored; clippy PASS; fmt PASS. No test assertions or conformance/ fixtures touched. Hand back for acto-critic re-audit.
